semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Punctuation/Noise artifact in a list of attendees or entities (Regional Implementing Agencies, World Bank staff).
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Isolated punctuation token within a sentence fragment describing participants.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Represents a non-informative textual artifact (comma sequence) likely resulting from OCR errors or formatting noise. It does not carry semantic weight distinct from surrounding context.

semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Punctuation/Noise artifact closing a quoted title.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Isolated punctuation token following a quoted event title and preceding the acronym definition.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Represents a non-informative textual artifact (comma sequence) likely resulting from OCR errors or formatting noise. It serves as a delimiter in the source text but carries no independent semantic content.
